text.en:
The reduction of the assessed value of all permanent plants and/or trees on any taxable real
property in any province by fifty per cent pending a new assessment of such plants and/or trees, pursuant to
the proviso contained in the second paragraph of section fifty-three of Commonwealth Act numbered Four
hundred and seventy, known as the 'Assessment Law,' is declared ineffective, and the said proviso is

This Act shall take effect as of January one, nineteen hundred and forty.
Approved, May 26, 1940.
